summary: Farmmi, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial report for the six months ended March 31, 2026, with subsequent events related to Atlas Sciences LLC and share issuances. This is a routine periodic report under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, disclosing operational and financial results, not a special-situation transaction. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign is indicated. The filing is an ordinary current report of financial statements and business updates, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
